About a quarter of the tickets for "Sugar Skull Cash" have been sold. The game is still new. The key question is whether the tickets or the top prizes run out first. Right now, the top prizes are being claimed more slowly than the tickets are selling, which is a good sign.

Tomorrow's count on "Sugar Skull Cash" will be a little different. The game sells every day, and this page keeps track.
